 # Remove extra spaces and special characters
 value = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', value).strip().lower()

 value = re.sub(r'government -', 'government', value)
 value = re.sub(r'proprietary', 'proprietary', value)
 value = re.sub(r'prilate', 'private', value)  # Assuming this is a typo for 'private'
 value = re.sub(r'z church', 'church', value)

 # Ensure uniformity by converting to lowercase and removing hyphens
 value = re.sub(r'-', '', value)
 value = value.lower()

 # Return the cleaned hospital ownership type
 return value
